assumptions.text: The LabTrust-Gym simulation semantics are the operational model for this demo.
The role policy in policy/pcs/roles.yaml defines release authorization.
The exported trace is complete for the run.
The QC event in the trace represents successful QC completion.
The demo is a research/simulation artifact, not a clinical deployment.

claim.text: A sample may be released only after accession, QC completion, analysis, authorization by a release-capable actor, and satisfaction of the required temporal protocol constraints.
